# Deborah Rose Real Estate Group

> Deborah Rose Miller (also published as "Deborah Rose") is a Texas real estate broker (TREC license 622917) and the owner of Deborah Rose Real Estate Group, powered by eXp Realty LLC. She helps buyers and sellers in the Lake Houston area and Montgomery County, Texas.

- Name: Deborah Rose Miller. Also known as Deborah Rose.
- Business: Deborah Rose Real Estate Group, powered by eXp Realty LLC. Deborah is the owner and broker.
- Phone: (281) 380-0332
- Email: deborahroserealtor@gmail.com
- Based in: Porter, TX 77365 (service-area business; no public office address)
- Areas served: Kingwood, Humble, Atascocita, Porter, New Caney, Conroe, Magnolia and Stagecoach, Texas. The Lake Houston area and Montgomery County.
- Credentials: Texas real estate broker, REALTOR, Houston Association of REALTORS member, HAR Platinum agent, Real Estate Negotiation Expert (RENE), Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist (CLHMS), Five Star Real Estate Agent award winner.
- Background: fifty plus years across the financial industry, school trustee service and municipal government. Thirty-six years in the financial industry (1972 to 2008), including twenty-five years as owner of Rose Financial Group.
- Community: Director and past chair, Humble ISD Education Foundation. Board member, Greater Magnolia Chamber of Commerce. Member, Greater East Montgomery County Chamber of Commerce. Past director, Partnership Lake Houston. Co-founder and founding president, Magnolia Education Foundation (2001). Past president, Magnolia Community Foundation. Nine years on the Magnolia ISD Board of Trustees, two as president. Former Economic Development Coordinator, City of Magnolia. Director and past chairman, Magnolia-Tomball YMCA. Founding member, Magnolia Rotary Club; member, Summer Creek Rotary Club.
